name: Esthetic
description:
## Description

"A universal player that pursues cost-performance while maintaining the basic performance of the DV-50s.Audio circuitThe 24bit D/A conversion system with up24bit D/A conversion system with up-conversion function.Upconverts digital audio data up to 1536kHz (DVD-Audio/Video) and 1411.2kHz (CD) with 2nd generation RDOT algorithm and high-sampling FIR digital filter.This output is input to an advanced segment-type D/A converter, which is robust to dynamic characteristics and clock jitter, and is converted into an analog signal. The D/A converter has a 4dac configuration with L/R � differential operation, enabling more accurate D/A conversion.The SACD is played in DSD mode, and the front panel is equipped with a digital filter mode selector switch and up-convert frequency indicator.Refined Digital Output Technology (RDOT) is an analog-based interpolation technology based on full entropy theory that reproduces sounds at frequencies above 20kHz that are truncated in the CD format.The I-V conversion circuit that receives the output from the D/A converter uses an ultra-high slew rate operational amplifier manufactured by National Semiconductor.A high-speed operational amplifier manufactured by Analog Devices Inc. is used for synthesizing the audio differential signal and for the active low-pass filter.A 4-layer glass-epoxy substrate is used for the substrate. The ground layer and the power layer are dedicated to each other, thereby achieving low impedance of the ground and the power and stable circuit operation and sound quality are achieved.The power supply section uses a series power supply using an R-core transformer that has been carefully examined for sound quality instead of a switching power supply.We use carefully selected high-quality parts that have a reputation for sound quality after trial listening.Equipped with a video off function, it is possible to stop the operation of the video circuit when playing DVD-Audio, SACD, CD, etc. and prevent interference with the sound quality of the video signal.Video circuitThe video output has a progressive scan circuit.By connecting to a TV or projector that supports progressive input, you can maximize the quality of your DVD.2-3pull-down pure cinema progressive scan processing or 3-D motion-adaptive complementary processing, depending on the film material and video material, enabling more realistic reproduction.Progressive playback of PAL discs is possible in addition to conventional NTSC.The video DAC uses ADV7314, a 14bit/216MHz video DAC manufactured by Analog Devices Inc.This DAC achieves high-quality D/A conversion by over-sampling 16times in the interlace method and 8times in the progressive method. At the same time, the NSV processing shifts the video noise component to the unwanted band and the analog filter effectively eliminates the noise.The video circuit uses a low-pass filter and high-speed video amplifier with special emphasis on group delay characteristics, and amplifies the information extracted from the source without losing it.The four layer glass-epoxy circuit board has two layers assigned to the signal system and the other two layers assigned to the ground layer and power supply layer. Therefore, stable ground potential and low high-frequency impedance power supply to each circuit are achieved. In addition, interference between circuit blocks is prevented, power supply circuits are separated thoroughly, and interference between video signals is reduced. As a result, images with stable details are reproduced.A DVI-D connector for Digital Content Copy Protection Signal (HDCP) is installed as a digital output of video signals.When combined with a projector equipped with a DVI input terminal, full digital transmission without image quality degradation due to repeated AD/DA conversion is realized.OtherThe mechanism part inherits the concept of high rigidity and non-resonance structure of the DV-50. It has a structure in which a steel mechanical ASSY reinforced with a mechanical housing is firmly fixed with two brackets.The chassis structure adopts full body construction with a mass of 16kg, with 5mm thick steel for the bottom plate and 1.6mm thick steel for the top plate.The front panel is finished with a newly developed short scratch process.3-point support by newly developed hardened steel pinpoint foot is adopted for the leg part.These legs have a structure in which the screws that are fixed directly to the bottom plate function as pin-point feet. In addition, the pins and saucer are integrated with the bottom plate of the main body, so there is no need to worry about installation.Uses an AC cable that emphasizes resolution and texture.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"A CD-player using 1-bit Mash system.1bitMASH system is adopted for D/A conversion part.The 1-bit Mash is based on a clock generated by ultra-precision crystal oscillation. While the vertical axis (amplitude axis) is fixed at 1bit, the horizontal axis (time axis) is highly accurate. This realizes the noise-shaping system, which is a D/A conversion system with excellent differential linearity and very little gradation error.In the CD-P400, this 1-bit Mash eliminates the 0cross distortion and achieves excellent linearity at low levels. In addition, quantization noise is minimized in the audible band, ensuring excellent S/N ratio.A midship mounting system is adopted in which the entire mechanism is placed in the center of the housing.As a result, the transformer with a large weight mass is positioned in the center of the body and moved to the back panel side at the same time. The internal layout completely separates the servo system (digital) from the audio system (analog) through the mechanism to achieve a symmetrical layout. In addition, the center of mass and massive parts are placed as close as possible to ensure an ideal chassis balance. This prevents interference between the left and right circuits and greatly improves durability.In addition, a foot base containing special glass fiber with low vibration mode is adopted for the mechanical base, and a highly rigid mechanical system is formed by the three point support which is strong against torsion, and vibration and resonance are completely eliminated. In addition, it has the effect of stabilizing tracing capability and servo.The servo mechanism is equipped with a newly developed CN servo.In the conventional servo mechanism, when the servo amount is too large, the disturbance of the current forms a noise component, which adversely affects the analog system. In the CN servo, unnecessary noise components other than the servo current are filtered using a low-pass filter to filter the driving voltage to the actuator, thereby dramatically reducing the servo current.Equipped with TEAC'Ωs original T. F. H. S. (Track &ΩFocus Holding System).TFHS accurately reads the tracking error signal (up and down) and the focus error signal (left and right) when there is a scratch or dirt on the disk surface. The pickup maintains the trace signal just before the scratch or dirt as it is. After passing through the scratch or dirt, it immediately starts to accurately read the pits of the same track. This prevents sound skipping and ensures stable pickup ability even against black dots.By installing this mechanism, stable pit reading and high-precision tracing capability are obtained at any position from the inner circumference to the outer circumference of any disk, and the amount of change in servo current is greatly reduced.In order to eliminate the effects of vibration and resonance, the front panel is made of drawn aluminum material with sufficient thickness and weight, and it is joined to the bonnet made of PVC thick steel plate as a double structure. In addition, the tray top panel and the front panel are flush surfaces with no steps to cope with air vibration from the front, back, and left and right.In addition, only the necessary keys are placed on the front and the opening is minimized to eliminate the influence of sound pressure.Equipped with editing function convenient for cassette editing.You can display the accumulated time every time you program a song you want to record. It is also equipped with a pause program mechanism that allows you to program poses.It is equipped with index search, random memory program of up to 20songs, delete program, music scan and music search.Equipped with a cue lock function, you can search for music without holding down the fast forward or fast return buttons.Equipped with four types of repeat functions : one track, all tracks, programs, and between A and B.Equipped with 3-mode time counter.Equipped with an auto space function that can set the interval between songs of about 4seconds.Equipped with a timer play function, you can start playing from the desired time by combining with an optional timer.Wireless remote control is included."

"This is a CD-player that combines the VRDS mechanism of Eso Telik with the DAC of Wadia Inc.The D/A converter is equipped with a differential balance D/A circuit developed by Wadia exclusively for the VRDS mechanism.In this circuit, the digital signal read by the VRDS mechanism is resampled by a factor of 8in a digital filter. The gate array also operates a sine wave moving average circuit to minimize conversion errors.Wadia'Ωs know-how has been fully applied to the DAC usage and substrate layout that maintain the time axis accuracy of these digital processing units.The balanced output of the 4dac is delivered directly to the XLR connector without passing through an analog filter. This is a high-definition specification.It is equipped with a sine wave moving average circuit which is also installed in D-3.When performing further over-sampling after 8times over-sampling, a simple moving average results in a linear interpolation, resulting in a significant error from the original signal. The sine wave moving average circuit installed in the X-10w realizes 12/24over-sampling by placing an interpolation value on the sine wave, thereby minimizing phase distortion in the analog interpolation in the latter stage.The VRDS mechanism is used for the mechanism part.In this mechanism, the disk is securely clamped on a high-mass turntable with the same diameter as the disk, and the inherent vibration of the disk itself and unnecessary vibration of the mechanism system are completely eliminated. In addition, warpage and distortion of the disk are corrected by giving an extremely gentle inclination to the disk crimping surface. The pickup, which is finely adjusted to the same angle as the inclination angle of the turntable, always realizes pit reading at the center of the pickup optical axis. This has succeeded in greatly improving the relative optical axis accuracy between the optical pickup and the disk pit surface, and minimizes unnecessary servo current.These greatly reduce disk read errors and prevent timing errors (jitter) in the clock circuit.In the X-10w VRDS mechanism, high-precision die-cast aluminum is used for the turntable, supported by a bridge with thick reinforced rib structure.The mechanical base is made of a special polymer material that has a low coefficient of thermal expansion and resistance to temperature changes. This material has twice the specific gravity of ABS resin. Not only is it excellent in electrical and mechanical properties, it also contributes to high dimensional accuracy.The motor uses a brushless Hall motor that boasts high torque to provide rotational stability and high durability. name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"CD player with TEAC'Ωs original ZD circuit.The ZD 3000omits the 10keys of the body and the volume adjustment from the remote controller that was installed in the ZD 5000.ZD circuit is used for the D/A conversion part.In the D/A conversion, quantization distortion occurs at the time of conversion, and this quantization distortion tends to increase especially at low levels and when the input level is slowly converted. To reduce this, a method using a kind of digital signal called dither signal was known in theory, but in reality, it had not been put into practical use due to the capacity of the D/A converter and the difficulty of subtraction processing to extract the dither component from the analog signal.TEAC took note of this problem and developed an ZD circuit as a D/A conversion method using dither signals, which is incorporated into the ZD 3000.The ZD circuit adds a 12-bit dither signal to the input digital signal and converts it directly into analog signal through a high-resolution D/A converter. Only the dither component is accurately removed from the analog signal, thereby dispersing quantization distortion and greatly reducing odd order harmonic distortion, which is considered harmful to hearing.In addition to the original effect of dither by introducing a dither signal, the error of the D/A converter can be averaged and the accuracy of the D/A converter is improved to minimize product variations.In the ZD 3000, the analog parts including the D/A converter are configured independently on the left and right sides in order to reduce mutual interference and cross modulation distortion. The most important part is enclosed in a 64-pin one chip LSI (ZD Digital LSI) to improve reliability.Equipped with 2x oversampling digital filter.By doubling the sampling frequency with the digital filter to 88.2kHz, unwanted high-frequency components can be pushed up to 60kHz, so that the low-pass filter curve can be adjusted gently to protect the very high-frequency components that are important for expressing the mood and nuance of music.The pickup section uses a high-speed 3-beam laser pickup driven by a linear motor.In addition to the main beam that reads the music signal from the disc, the 3-beam Laser Pickup uses two sub-beams dedicated to tracking servo. When tracking error occurs, the sub-beam quickly catches the error, feeds back to the position correction of the main beam, and accurately reads the information contained in the disc.In addition, by adopting a linear motor drive for the pickup drive, access speed is twice as high as that of conventional models, while operating noise is reduced and access is smooth.A floating insulation system is used for the whole signal reading part including the pickup to shut out external vibration.It has a 20-track random memory program function.ZD-3000can be operated with the attached remote control.It is equipped with a direct random play function, and you can directly cue the music you specify with 10keys.Equipped with a one touch song selection function, you can search the head of the current or next song with one touch.It has an intro check function, and you can play the head part of each song for 10seconds one after another.If you press the PLAY button during an intro check, the music will be played from that song.Equipped with manual search.It is possible to carry out a continuous manual search in two and then speeds up.It is equipped with an index search, and by specifying an index number, you can find out the beginning of a song in more detail.It is possible to play all songs / memory / A-B with 3types of copy and playback.Timer playback is possible by linking with the separately sold timer.Equipped with two outputs, fixed and variable.It uses a multi-function display that allows you to instantly check the status of the disc and player, such as song number, index number, playing time, etc.It is equipped with one touch front loading function, and when you set the disk and press the PLAY button, it automatically loads and moves to regenerating condition.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to do most of the operation at hand."

description:

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"This SCMS compatible DAT deck inherits the functions and mechanism from the TASCAM brand professional DAT and the sound quality from the ESOTERIC brand DAT/R-1.A 1-bit A/D converter is used.This method converts an analog signal into a pulse wave and directly converts the width of the pulse wave into a digital signal. Furthermore, by using a fourth order noise shaving circuit, the noise in the audio signal pass band is shifted to a much higher frequency band. As a result, both low-level signals and small signals contained in high-level signals can be digitized with high linearity and fidelity to the original sound.In principle, no 0cross distortion occurs and no phase shift occurs.The D/A converter uses an 8-times oversampling 18-bit digital filter.In order to create a DAT system based on the recording and playback of the original sound, thick steel plates and side woods are used for the casing, and vibration control sheets are also attached to the top panel to eliminate resonance.In addition, the mechanical part is housed in a U-shaped dedicated chassis and integrated with the base chassis to suppress the generation and propagation of vibration.In addition, to avoid mutual interference, each block such as power supply, mechanical, display and signal converter is completely separated and laid out, and the internal chassis is shielded to eliminate mutual electrical and physical interference between each section and further increase the rigidity of the case.In addition, a large insulator made of a high-density material combined with special ceramics, which has high internal loss and excellent vibration absorption, is used to construct a thorough vibration-free and interference-free construction.The Sendust Patter Head is used for recording and reproducing digital signals on tape. It has high reliability, high output, and excellent durability.To improve the overall sound quality, the circuit board is a double-sided board that realizes the shortest wiring distance. Audio parts such as a completely independent wound power transformer, an independent rectifier circuit, and a large-capacity capacitor are used to provide a high sound quality design.The front part uses a gold panel of aluminum drawing material and has a simple layout of keys for basic functions and subcodes. The large keys provide reliable and reliable operation.In addition, the large FL display panel and LED indicators on the control keys make it easy to check whether the product is operating or not even when operated from a remote location by remote control.It is equipped with tape operation function using subcode.Equipped with direct search, skip search, intro check, end search, blank search, 3x queue, review function, 9x search function (remote control), etc.The input volume is a differential left-right interlocking type in which the other moves precisely in accordance with the rotation of the other.You can adjust both LRs first and then turn one knob to control both LRs volume while maintaining the balance.In addition to usability, the channel separation has been improved by more than 10dB compared to the conventional volume.The start ID that indicates the beginning of a song can be automatically recorded by detecting the level of the song to be recorded.If you want to add a Start ID or change the position of a tape edit, you can use the Rehearse function to record a Start ID or Skip ID while listening to a recorded song.Since the recording position is ¥0.15seconds (in five frame units), the operation of playing after searching does not cause the head of the song to be chipped.After editing, you can use the renumbering function to repeat the song number from the beginning of the tape.Equipped with a large 17-segment digital peak meter with high visibility.In addition, it is equipped with a dimmer function that can control the brightness of the display in 4stages (it can be done by remote control).Multi-functional wireless remote control included."

description:
## Description

"This tape deck is designed to improve its high performance and operability by integrating 20years of experience and know-how of deck making and the latest technology.The mechanism section employs a direct drive system using a DC servo electronic commutator motor. The direct drive system has the advantage of less slip and uneven rotation due to the reduction mechanism. In addition, the 88mm � outer rotor type flywheel and high-precision capstan realizes an excellent rotation mechanism.The A-5300motor has a servo detection coil wound in parallel with the drive coil. When the motor rotates, the servo detection coil generates a voltage proportional to the number of rotations. This voltage is converted into a control voltage and sent to the servo amplifier of the motor. When the rotation speed increases, the motor drive voltage is lowered. When the rotation speed decreases, the voltage is increased. In order to obtain accurate rotation, we use capstan shafts manufactured with a precision of 0.15microns in roundness.The reel motor uses a DC-reel motor that provides ideal torque against tape tension and is less susceptible to cocking and vibration, resulting in improved high-frequency flutter characteristics.The compact and lightweight design also reduces heat generation and power consumption, improving efficiency. In addition, the brake mechanism of the motor also protects the tape from damage.An IC logic control circuit is used in the drive section of the tape deck. In combination with a soft-touch keyboard switch, all operating modes are electronically controlled.The operation of the mechanism is controlled by a logic circuit using more than 10ICs, and the highly reliable keyboard switches used in desktop computers are used as frequently used switches.By combining this IC logic control circuit and DC motor, the output signal of each mode of the IC logic circuit drives the switching circuit of the transistor and activates the plunger solenoid motor, which reduces click noise during operation.Equipped with a real-time pause mechanism.In the A-5300, in addition to the plunger for constant speed running, the plunger solenoid for pause is used for the plunger that operates the pinch roller. This allows the pinch roller to pull in the lifter when entering a pause from recording mode, allowing the tape to remain in contact with the head for erasing, recording, and playback. In addition, the pinch roller does not return to the stop state as with the conventional pause mechanism. Because the pinch roller is located very close to the capstan, the tape is sent as soon as you start recording.It is equipped with an independent selector switch that provides the optimum bias and equalizer for low-noise and regular tapes, and with a level selector switch that allows the recording level to be 3VU higher, taking advantage of the 3-5dB dynamic margin of low-noise tapes.Equipped with a high-precision, large double-scale expanded type VU meter.It is linked with the level selector switch, and the maximum level can be adjusted to plus 6vu (high) or plus 3vu (normal) depending on the tape used.High hardness permalloy head is used for the head.It uses a volume equipped with memory markers that are convenient for marking input and output levels.Oatley verse is possible by attaching sensing foils to the end of the tape (base side). Also, if you attach foils to the beginning and end of the tape (magnetic side), it will be repeated playback g red brain.The microphone input and the line input are fed independently by the circuit design, making it possible to mix the microphone and line.Equipped with a shut-off arm that stops the mechanism automatically when the tape is finished winding.Equipped with a 4-digit index counter that is convenient for finding the beginning of the program position.It is equipped with a reel stand height adjustment mechanism so that the tape does not rub against the reel and get damaged depending on the thickness of the reel.It uses a quick lock reel clamper and can set the reel just by turning the shaft to the right.Equipped with two Input/Output terminals that can be used by two systems.Timer recording / playback is possible by combining the timer control adapter and timer (sold separately).Operation from a remote location is possible by using the separately sold remote control unit."

description:
## Description

"An open reel deck developed as the top of a four track deck.Equipped with a Oatley berth regeneration mechanism.If you apply a sensing foil to the area where you want the tape to be reversed, the tape will be automatically reversed from forward to reverse. description:
## Description

"This is a separate type master recorder that embodies the idea of a teac for a high-grade two track deck.Equipped with tension servo mechanism and impedance roller.With the tension servo mechanism, the left tension arm detects changes in back tension caused by changes in the winding diameter of the feed reel, and feeds these changes back to the reel motor to keep the tension value within the optimum range at all times. This allows the tape to be protected by providing optimum tension even during constant speed running or rapid winding, and provides stable head touch. The speed change from the beginning to the end of winding is also minimal.In addition, excellent wow and flutter characteristics have been obtained by the synergistic effect of the impedance roller with the large flywheel effect.It uses a direct function logic circuit, so that it can be switched directly from any mode without going through the stop button.Equipped with a motion sensing mechanism, when the PLAY button is pressed from the quick winding, the tape stops and the vehicle quickly moves to constant speed running.This mechanism is equipped with a motion sensor that consists of a magnet and a magnetic diode incorporated in the guide roller. It sensitively catches the movement of the tape and operates to issue a command to immediately move to the next mode.Equipped with NAB/BTS equalizer switching mechanism.At 38cm speeds, BTS equalization can improve the overall signal-to-noise ratio by approximately 2dB compared to NAB by adding more high-frequency compensation during recording and reducing compensation during playback.The erase head uses a full-track erase head that completely covers the width of the tape, and even 4-track recorded tapes can be erased cleanly.In addition, the recording mode switch is of the same type for L and R to eliminate erroneous operation.Equipped with 6-step switching of bias and continuously variable equalizer function, it is compatible with commercially available tapes and tapes expected to be commercially available in the future.The tape monitor switch has a CAL position in addition to the conventional Source and Tape positions.When the CAL button is pressed, the meter is calibrated to 0VU = JIS standard level regardless of the position of the output volume. This can be used to check the recording level of tape or to use amplifiers or headphones with widely different input sensitivities.In the OUT position, the meter indication is linked to the output volume.A separate structure has been adopted to allow more freedom of installation.The head housing is an opening and closing type.In addition, the shield case of the read head is installed on the opening / closing lid, making it easy to use Derma and graph and easy to maintain.It has a queueing mechanism.High-speed monitoring is possible by pushing up the cue lever in the state of quick winding.It uses a 4-track playhead.High hardness permalloy head is used for the head.Equipped with a recording mode standby lamp.When the recording mode switch is turned ON, the red REC lamp flashes. When recording starts, the lamp lights up to indicate that recording is being performed.Equipped with an independent volume fine adjustment mechanism for left and right channels.In addition, it is equipped with a left-right interlocking master volume for easy operation such as fade in / fade out.For playback, there is also an independent fine-tuning volume for left and right channels and a master volume linked to left and right channels.The regeneration reference level of the master volume is the point indicated as 0VU.Equipped with peak indicator.The lighting level is + 12dB at 38cm speed and + 10dB at 19cm speed. Since the lighting level is fixed for at least 70ms depending on the memory circuit, there is no detection error.Equipped with a microphone attenuator.A timer recording and re-mechanism can be added by installing a timer control adapter sold separately.Equipped with a separately sold remote control unit, it can be operated from a remote location."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo tape deck that thoroughly pursues performance to meet the needs of professionals and audiophiles.A 3-motor system is used for the mechanism.A 4-pole, 8-pole, 2-speed hysteresis synchronous motor is used for the capstan motor, and a 6-pole eddy current motor with bearings is used for the reel motor. However, fast forward and rewind are designed not to directly enter playback. Combined with a full-fledged brake mechanism, this switch allows smooth operation without damaging the tape.Equipped with a foil sensing stop function, it can be auto-stopped or auto-rewound at the desired position by attaching a conductive foil sensing tape to the back of the tape. name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"A tape deck based on A-7030GSL and equipped with new mechanism.The head consists of four heads, two track erase-record-playback heads, plus a four track playback head, enabling you to play four track tapes.A high-hardness permalloy head is used for the recording / reproducing head.Careful consideration is given to the machining accuracy and assembly of each head core, and the accuracy of gap width is also improved, resulting in flat characteristics.In addition, the head shape is hyperbolic and the head touch is stable.It is equipped with a peak level meter that can confirm the peak of the signal.The VU meter, which has been used to monitor the recording level, is designed to indicate the average value of the signal waveform in order to grasp the sense of volume, whereas the peak level meter is designed to indicate the peak value of the signal waveform and can monitor the pulse component contained in the signal used in raw recording.In general, even if a pulse signal with an attack time shorter than 10ms is clipped and distorted, it is difficult to perceive it as distortion in the sense of hearing. Therefore, the peak level meter of A-7030mkIV uses an attack time of 10ms. The recovery time of 750ms is long, making it easier to read the high-speed response of the indicator. In addition, in order to monitor the dynamic range, the scale instructions range is expanded from -40dB to + 5dB with a logarithmic amplifier. Moreover, the interval of the scale around 0dB is widened, making it easier to read.Equipped with a bias equalizer independent 2-stage switching mechanism to cope with low-noise tapes.A 3-motor mechanism is used for the mechanism part.In addition, the mechanism is firmly supported by the 6mm thick panel chassis configuration that combines aluminum and stainless steel.The combination of a smoothly rotating impedance roller that absorbs the wow flutter and a tension arm that absorbs the rough motion of the tape at the start ensures stable tape travel.It uses a new reel clamper that does not need a correction sheet and can easily attach the No. 10reel.It has a cue button.If you press the Q button in the fast-forward state, you can monitor the sound and find the beginning of the song or the position you want to edit.The microphone input and line input volumes are designed to be independent, making it possible to mix the microphone and line.Simultaneous monitoring is possible.It uses a tension changeover switch that can be used with No. 10/ No. 7reels.By combining the separately sold remote control unit, it can be operated from a remote location.Timer recording / playback is possible by combining the timer control adapter sold separately with the timer."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"Master recorder incorporating the latest technology and know-how of TEAC in magnetic recorder.In order to improve the mounting accuracy of impedance rollers, tension arms, heads, etc. that play an important role in the tape running system, we have adopted a die-cast base that has undergone high-precision processing and does not change over time.The impedance roller with excellent dynamic balance absorbs uneven tape travel and wow / flutter, resulting in smooth tape travel. In addition, the oil-dump-type tension arm provides constant, stable tension, smooth start-up, and prevents sound skipping.By shortening the distance between the capstan and the head and between the heads, and by taking the optimum touch angle between the tape and the head, modulation noise is reduced.The counter-roller combined with the tension arm that keeps the winding angle of the tape constant prevents uneven running of the tape.A DC servo electronic commutator motor is used for the motor of the running system.The DC servo electronic commutator motor is driven at 24V and electronically controlled by a servo detection circuit to keep the rotational speed constant at all times. In addition, there is no mechanical contact at all, eliminating noise caused by friction and performance degradation caused by wear.The operation of the mechanism is controlled by a logic circuit using an IC. Since there is no mechanical contact such as relay, highly reliable mode operation is possible.In addition, the direct function method is adopted, and free operation such as direct PLAY from FF/REW is possible.In addition, it is also possible to make a follow-up recording that enters the recording mode in the middle of playback.Equipped with a peak level meter with a scale range of -40dB to + 5dB. An electronic circuit with a response time of 10ms is used to handle pulse sounds with short duration, enabling accurate indication.Equipped with four microphone inputs, two microphones can be set for each L/R channel, and 2-channel mixing recording with four microphones is possible. Also equipped with two line inputs for each L/R channel, and line-to-line mixing recording is possible.Mixing recording of 2lines of microphone and line is also possible.The power supply voltage of the microphone amplifier is as high as 45v, and the voltage utilization factor is increased by the combination of PNP-NPN transistor and direct coupling and dynamic margin is greatly improved.In order to prevent distortion of the microphone amplifier due to excessive input during on-microphone operation, an L/R independent microphone attenuator with 20dB attenuation is used.Equipped with a record master volume, all input levels can be controlled by a single volume.Memory marker with Klix/Kluk? top is mounted on input volume.When you turn the volume to a preset position, you can check the position by clicking stop.It has a queuing mechanism so that when you push the cue lever up in fast-forward mode, you can monitor the sound so you can see the beginning of a song or where you want to edit, or when you put it into a playback pose so that the tape touches the head so you can manually rotate the reel to check the exact edit position.Equipped with an editing mechanism. When the switch is turned ON and a PLAY operation is performed, the take-up reel stops and the tape is sent out.An opening and closing type head housing mechanism is adopted.Equipped with pitch control, tape speed can be changed within ¥5% range.It is equipped with a linear counter that can read the tape running amount with the terminal of minute second.The accuracy of the counter is within ¥1.5%.Uses a high hardness permalloy head.Equipped with MPX filter.It is equipped with a 3-step tape selector independent of bias and equalizer.Equipped with a real-time pause mechanism.Equipped with a 4-track playback head.Equipped with an output volume that click-stops at a precise reference level.Equipped with a memory auto-stop mechanism that stops at the preset counter position when rewinding.Timer recording / playback is possible by using the timer sold separately.There was a full remote control mechanism sold separately."

name: TEAC30-4
description:
## Description

"A 4-channel tape deck equipped with a simulsink mechanism.At that time, TASCAM was not branded, and 30-4and 20-4were named Tascam series.The model 30-4is an upgraded model of the A-3340S in detail, and it is equipped with a function selector with greatly improved switches so that the simulsync recording can be performed with as simple operation as possible.It is equipped with a simulsync mechanism necessary for multiple recording.When you overlay sound on a tape deck, the sound on each track must be completely synchronized. A typical tape deck has separate recording and playback heads, so if you overlay sound while monitoring playback sound, the sound will shift by the distance between the heads.With the simulsync mechanism, the first recorded sound is monitored by the recording head, not by the reproducing head, so that it can be recorded directly onto another track without causing recording slippage between tracks.Equipped with an output selector.The SOURCE position adjusts the recording level. In this case, the input signal appears on the meter and output terminal. The SYNC position plays the sound with the recording head in a simul-sync mode. The input signal or simul-sync playback signal can be monitored in conjunction with the four function selectors on the left.In the PLAY position, the playhead operates and the playback sound can be monitored.The Function Selector functions as both a recording mode switch and a tape monitor switch.When the Output Selector is in the SYNC position and the Function Selector is OFF, the SimulSync regenerating condition occurs and the Recording Mode is OFF. When the Function Selector is ON, the LED above the switch blinks and the Recording Mode is ON (Recording Standby) to monitor the input signal. With this Function Selector, you can switch both the Recording Mode ON/OFF and the Tape Monitor (Input / Excess Sync Playback) simultaneously with a single operation, simplifying the complex operation of multiple recording.Equipped with a headphone selector, you can monitor the sound of any one to four channels individually or as a mix.All signals are located at the center of the headphones.Equipped with a pitch control function that works for both recording and playback, pitch adjustment of ¥6% (approximately half tone) is possible.It has a built-in motion sensing mechanism that enables smooth operation of the mechanism.When you move from fast forward or rewind to play, you don'Ωt have to wait for another action because the reel stops and immediately switches to play.The microphone or line can be switched to each input channel with a switch.When the microphone input is too large, the microphone attenuator attenuates the signal by 20dB.It is equipped with a cue mechanism that can be used to start a song.Equipped with a reel clamper that allows one touch attachment of the reel."

description:
## Description

"This sound reflector was developed as a full-fledged AV speaker, not as a conventional AV speaker, based on TEAC'Ωs unique technology of large vibrating plate and enclosure-less structure.Typical audio speakers have been developed to have flat characteristics when measured without a classroom, and when installed in a listening room, they have large peaks and valleys.However, in an actual concert hall, when measured at the seat of the audience, reflected sound from walls and ceilings interferes with each other, resulting in complicated acoustic characteristics with fine mountains and valleys becoming dense. This creates a hall tone called a scattered wave sound field.In the S-2001, it is very difficult to reproduce this hall tone with a speaker with flat characteristics. Therefore, it was developed based on the reverse idea that a speaker with characteristics similar to those of a concert hall should be created from the beginning.The unit consists of a thin baffle at the top, a cone-type tweeter in the center, and a polymer-based diaphragm (63cmx35cm), which is completely fixed to the surrounding frame to control the natural vibration of the rectangular plate and to realize natural hall tone without coloring or peculiarity.In addition, the voice coil bobbin of the driver is made of ???????? that can withstand high temperatures of 200?, the surface treatment of the diaphragm with a combination of special plastic coating and Japanese paper, and the position of the driver is determined by computer analysis. Through various techniques and thorough trial listening, realistic sound quality is obtained.The enclosure-less structure enables realistic sound reproduction with sharp rise and good sound separation.In addition, the balance between the reflected sound and the main sound is thoroughly pursued, and lines and other sounds are clearly reproduced in a rich mid-range.The large diaphragm (54cm diameter in general cone type) enables rich bass reproduction.In addition, the enclosure-less structure ensures that the sound profile is not lost even during low-frequency boosting.It is a high-efficiency design that can reproduce even with a small output amplifier.Thin and lightweight design allows for not only floor placement but also hanging installation.There are 3color variations of brown, ivory and black."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"A 3-head stereo cassette deck equipped with dbx.Dbx is a professional standard noise reduction system developed for recording studios. When recording a strong sound exceeding the allowable dynamic range of a tape (55dB to 60dB), the level of the sound is compressed to 1/ 2of the original sound, and the level is doubled during playback. This method ensures the dynamic range of the original sound.In addition, the noise level is reduced by 30dB to 40dB over the entire band, and the inherent noise of the tape is reduced to a level that is not an acoustic problem.Unlike other NR systems that change the frequency, this system performs linear logarithmic compression and expansion, eliminating the need for level matching and pilot tone due to differences in sensitivity of the tapes used.Uses a complete 2-motor system with 1motor for reel drive during FF, Rew and Play and 1motor for capstan drive.In addition, it incorporates a mechanical tension servo that provides constant speed and uniform head touch from the beginning to the end of winding.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism that can record the absence and play the alarm clock.Bias/EQ Independent 3-stage switching is possible. In addition, it is equipped with a differential type left / right interlocking volume that enables accurate level setting.Equipped with a Rec Mute mechanism.Equipped with a dedicated test input selector for tape adjustment.Equipped with a Bias/Rec Calibration mechanism that can fine-tune the recording bias and recording level.It is equipped with a memory mechanism that allows you to find the beginning of a song.Equipped with Dolby NR system.Can be mounted in EIA (19"") standard rack.There was a remote control unit and a rack handle sold separately."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"A cassette deck that can be used in a wide range of applications by installing a new mechanism in addition to the functions of the conventional tape deck.f-200VA is equipped with new functions such as simulsync recording, blend microphone and cross feed.In a simulsync recording, the left channel is recorded first. If you rewind and then press the simulsync button to start recording, the left channel becomes regenerating condition and only the right channel becomes recording. This allows you to record to the right channel while monitoring the left channel with your headphones. In this case, the meter for the left channel turns off and the simulsync recording is displayed. Unlike mixing lines and microphones, this function does not erase the sound of the left channel.For example, you can use it to record a guitar duet alone.The cross-feed allows sound to be spread appropriately.Simulsync Recorded sound can be played separately on the left and right side as it is. Crossfeed can be improved by making the left and right sound cross to the center, so that it can be played back as a natural stereo.With the Blend Microphone function, you can record mixed sound at the center.First, set the Input select button to Line and plug the microphone into the left channel. Then you can monitor and record line inputs such as records with headphones while simultaneously recording the sound from the blend microphone to the center.If you use a blend microphone during stereo playback, you can mix in the center position.Equipped with a memory switch.If you set the counter to 000at the beginning of the song and press the memory switch, it will stop automatically at 999when rewinding.By using the green VU meter, the recording level can be confirmed more clearly.High hardness permalloy head is used for the head.FG servo DC motor is used as the drive motor.This motor uses a built-in frequency generator (FG) to suppress changes in motor rotation caused by voltage and frequency fluctuations of the power supply.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a 2-stage bias / equalizer switching mechanism, recording and playback can be performed according to the characteristics of the tape.Equipped with timer mechanism, timer recording / playback is possible by combining with an audio timer sold separately.In addition, the f-200VA is equipped with a delay circuit so that it starts after the mechanism becomes stable a few seconds after the power is turned on.Equipped with line / microphone input selection switch.This switch allows the line input to be sent directly to the recording amplifier without passing through the microphone amplifier, eliminating distortion and noise when passing through the microphone amplifier and improving the dynamic range of the line input."

description:
## Description

"Auto-reverse deck with rotary head system.A rotary head system is adopted as the reverse system.Since the same head is used for both FWD and REV, this rotary head system has the advantage that the characteristics of both sides can be exactly unified. On the other hand, the head must be rotated mechanically, and high precision and durability are required for the rotating part.The newly developed A. R. H. S. (Acculine Rotating Head System) has been adopted in order to make this rotary head system perfect. In this A. R. H. S., the head holder and bearing part of the rotary part are made of high-precision die cast with high shock absorption power and light weight, processed in order of microns. This realizes a quiet rotational sound, reduces shocks and eliminates deviations in azimuth. In addition, by changing the diameters of the capstan and pinch roller and dispersing the wow flutter cycle, excellent stable running, improved wow flutter, and reduced modulation noise have been realized.It has a reflective IR (infrared) sensor to increase the reverse speed of the reverse deck.The IR sensor reduces time loss due to reflection by quickly optically detecting the semi-transparent tape attached to the end of the tape.The head uses a CA (cobalt amorphous) head using LC-OFC winding.By using the thin foil characteristic of amorphous alloy with no crystal structure, this head has realized a 13-layer laminate structure that is approximately four times larger than that of conventional Sendust heads. The ribbon-shaped amorphous alloy greatly reduces eddy current loss, improves MOL with excellent magnetic properties, achieves flat high-frequency characteristics, and achieves high wear resistance without grain boundary peeling.Most of the amplifier system from the input to the output of the signal is concentrated on a single board using many ICs, and by directly connecting the boards of the display and switches, noise prevention and wire shortening are realized.In addition, by carefully selecting parts such as aluminum electrolytic capacitors for high-sound audio and high-performance film capacitors, we minimize signal turbidity and degradation.The REC, PB, PB, and NR sections are each made into blocks to completely separate the power supply for the amplifier system from the power supply for the mechanism system. The transformer winding is also completely separated to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to mutual noise interference.A Dolby B/C is installed as a noise reduction system.A specially programmed LSI is mounted on the operation part to realize speedy control.As a system control, it judges various input states, determines the operation mode, and transmits it to the mechanical controller. It also reliably controls counter display, memory operation and CPS.The mechanism control controls the CAM motor to the specified position, controls the REEL motor, controls the amplifier control output, and displays the operation mode.Equipped with a bias fine function, the ability of the tape is brought out by adjusting the recording condition which differs depending on the tape to the optimum value.Equipped with a 2-way counter, tape counter and tape run timer can be selected with one touch.Equipped with a block repeat function, you can repeat playback between blocks specified by Start Memo and Stop Memo.Equipped with FL multi-function display."

name: V-580
description:
## Description

"This is a cassette deck with a simple structure that removes some functions and mechanisms from the V 680.The tape drive mechanism uses a high-precision electronic control motor to drive a capstan with extremely high roundness. The capstan is also equipped with a heavy-weight flywheel made of sintered alloy to increase inertial mass and greatly stabilize the driving force to improve tape running characteristics.The motor is mounted carefully to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to microvibration, and the cassette lid is made of high-rigidity hard resin to minimize vibration, thus minimizing the effect of resonance of the cassette half on sound quality.In the past, a coil was used in the resonance circuit of the recording equalizer of the recording amplifier. However, the phase shift that occurs as a high-frequency signal becomes a problem. Taking this into consideration, the TIC has eliminated the coil from the resonance circuit and integrated it into a newly developed linear recording amplifier that realizes accurate localization.In the amplifier circuit, the power supply to the REC, PB, and NR sections are all separated, and the power supply for the amplifier and the power supply for the mechanism section are completely separated from each other in terms of structure. This prevents interference and noise and reduces sound quality degradation. The ¥2power supply system makes the ground potential clear, reduces system noise and greatly improves the S / N ratio, as well as transient response characteristics and distortion factor.In addition, an all-DC configuration is adopted, and by directly connecting the head and amplifier to eliminate the capacitor, distortion factor and phase characteristics in the low-frequency range are greatly improved.In the circuit section, most parts of the amplifier system from signal input to output are mounted on a single board, and the display section and switches are also directly connected to the board to prevent noise generation and invasion. In addition, the transmission path is shortened naturally by the signal flow to prevent the loss of sound purity.We use high-quality audio parts such as an aluminum electrolytic capacitor designed for high-quality digital audio.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro Recording System.In this circuit, the optimum bias corresponding to the input signal is always applied to the tape to prevent the high-frequency recording capability from being degraded due to the high-level high-frequency signal acting as a bias, and the characteristics in the whole band are also improved.In addition, fluctuations in the magnetic field of the head and tape when recording high-level high-frequency signals, which cannot be avoided with a fixed bias, and a type of phase shift caused by these fluctuations, thereby greatly improving the orientation.Since tapes recorded with Dolby HX Pro are different from those recorded with NR, they can be played on decks without Dolby HX Pro.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a bias fine tuning function that can be adjusted within ¥20%.Equipped with Auto-Rec Mute which can make unrecorded part for about 4seconds.It uses a preset type master volume, and the level can be finely adjusted by double control.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects the tape position.Equipped with 2-mode electronic counter that can display tape counter and tape run.Equipped with FL multi-function display with microprocessor control.Large insulator with high damping effect is adopted.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"This is a real-time reverse deck that realizes 0.4second click reverse using original technology.Equipped with a real-time reverse function, it is possible to record continuously back and forth without reversing the cassette, and the time required for instantaneous reversal is 0.4seconds.This mechanism uses an IR (infrared ray) combination tape sensor unique to TEAC. This is structured so that the boundary between the recording tape and the reader tape is optically detected using infrared ray and inverted. By this, the sound cut when the tape is inverted is shortened so that it is hardly felt in the sense of hearing.Since this sensor operates even when the B-plane is inverted to the A-plane, reciprocating recording and repeat playback are possible.A ¥2power supply all-DC configuration amplifier circuit is used for the amplifier section.The head section is a 4-track head system. name: TEAC
description:
## Description

"This 3-head stereo cassette deck was developed using various technologies such as 3-motor, 3-head, triple noise reduction, Dolby HX, etc.A closed-loop dual capstan system is used for the mechanism.In order to ensure constant tape travel tension, we have adopted a dual capstan system in which the capstan and pinch rollers firmly hold the tape and drive it. This system achieves stable travel. In addition, by changing the diameter of each pinch roller, we have dispersed the wow / flutter cycle. In order to smoothly absorb small vibrations, we have adopted oil-impregnated plastic for the pinch roller bearings. In addition, by etching the capstan in sub-micron order to prevent tape slippage, we have improved the wow / flutter and reduced modulation noise.A large flywheel (complete mass : 1100g Ï‰ cm) shall be attached to the capstan shaft.2x2) to further enhance the stability.It is equipped with E Ï‰ M (Electro Mganetic) hysteresis tension servo developed by TEAC in order to aim at further stable driving.This system is the first in the world to be equipped with an electromagnetic hysteresis coupling for back tension control, enabling excellent tension characteristics equivalent to 4D. D.This E Ï‰ M hysteresis tension servo is an electromagnetic non-contact brake that is essentially different from commonly used friction brakes. It has little torque fluctuation and does not vary with temperature or humidity. In addition, the I. R. (infrared ray) photo-reflector detects the rotation speed of the reel and changes the current in the coil, so that constant tape tension is always obtained.In addition, a newly developed Fe-Mn semi-hardened magnetic material is used as a magnetic material to obtain the most effective brake torque and achieve a certain level of tape tension.A 3-motor system is adopted to realize 3S (Soft, Smooth, Silent).By using a dedicated motor for capstan drive, reel drive, and mechanism, stable driving and silent mechanism are realized.The head uses an independently suspended combination 3-head system, which provides the best azimuth accuracy for both the recording head and the reproducing head, and greatly improves the high-frequency and phase characteristics, which greatly affect the sound quality.The V-970X further integrates three heads for recording, playback, and erasing, and stores them in a precision large zinc die-cast head base, improving the accuracy of head position and achieving stable tape travel and accurate and uniform head touch.In addition, we have adopted a cobalt-amorphous (CA) head that uses LC-OFC (first class oxygen-free copper, purity 99.995%) winding that improves transmission characteristics. This head uses thin foil that is unique to amorphous alloys with no crystal structure. It has a 13-layer laminate structure that is approximately four times that of conventional Sendust heads. The ribbon-shaped amorphous alloy greatly reduces eddy current loss. This results in improved MOL with excellent magnetic characteristics, flat high-frequency characteristics, and high wear resistance without grain boundary peeling.In the power supply circuit, the Rec, PB, and NR sections are each divided into blocks to completely separate the power supply for the amplifier system from the power supply for the mechanism system. In addition, the winding of the transformer is completely separated to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to mutual noise interference.The ¥2power supply system clarifies the ground potential, reduces system noise and improves the S / N ratio, and also improves the response characteristics and distortion factor.In order to eliminate the effect of the condenser, the head and amplifier are directly connected and the condenser is eliminated.By integrating most of the amplifier system from the input to the output of the signal into a single circuit board, we aim at 3S (Simple, Straight, Small).In addition, the display and switches are connected directly to the board to prevent noise and reduce the length of wires. In addition, LC-OFC, which improves transmission characteristics, is used for the signal lead wires. In addition, parts such as aluminum electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors exclusively for audio, which are digital compatible and designed for high sound quality, are used to minimize signal degradation.Equipped with triple noise reduction (dbx, Dolby B/C).The dbxNR mounted on the V-970X uses an integrated L/R symmetrical one chip LSI to eliminate component variations and minimize degradation of sound quality. The encoding and decoding of dbxNR realizes an NR effect of 30to 40dB in the entire audible band, and the dynamic range of 110dB, which exceeds the limit of cassette tapes.In addition, the Dolby B/C NR uses a highly reliable one chip LSI to enhance compatibility with other decks.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro, which enhances the ability of high-frequency characteristics.The Dolby HX Pro has a feature that prevents the high-frequency signal applied to the recording head from operating as a bias when recording a deck. It detects the component of the signal above 10kHz and automatically controls it to reduce the bias when it is large, thereby improving the high-frequency reduction in high-level recording. This enables recording of ordinary tapes in the same manner as tapes with excellent high-frequency characteristics.Tapes recorded with Dolby HX Pro can also be played back by devices that do not have Dolby HX Pro. Since this circuit operates only during recording, no processing is required during playback.In order to optimize recording conditions that vary slightly depending on the tape being used, a BIAS &ΩLEVEL manual modulation mechanism is installed.The BIAS transmitter contains a master oscillator and a BIAS amplifier, which are also used in professional mTRs. The LEVEL can be controlled by ¥3dB and the BIAS by ¥20%.In order to realize highly accurate control, two dedicated microcomputers are installed.First, the system control LSI determines the operation mode by judging various input states and transmits it to the mechanism control. In addition, the system control LSI reliably controls counter display, memory operation and CPS.The mechanism control LSI controls the CAM motor to the specified position, controls the REEL motor, controls the amplifier control output, and displays the operation mode.In addition to the L/R, a new master volume is installed so that accurate volume adjustment can be performed.As a result, the operability is improved compared with the balance method and the L/R volume method in which the R image lowers when the L is raised.Equipped with a CD level check function, you can check the level of the entire song while the CD player is fast-forwarded.Normally, the CD player is fast-forwarded with the upper body lowered by 12dB. This is returned to the original level and displayed on the meter to enable accurate monitoring.Equipped with an auto monitor mechanism that automates the switching between tape monitor and source monitor.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects Normal/CrO2/Metal.It is equipped with a CPS system that searches and plays one song from the current song to the 15th song before and after it.It is equipped with a CDS system that searches for and plays back any songs from the beginning of the cassette.It is equipped with a block repeat function to repeat playback between two points.Equipped with 4-mode (tape counter / tape run timer / CPS count / CDS count) switching multi-electronic counter.Equipped with FL multi-function display controlled by microprocessor.Equipped with an MPX filter switch.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.Memory Stop / Memory Boost is available at any position.Equipped with an auto rec mute function of approximately 4seconds.Wireless remote controller with 16function keys is included."

"This cassette deck is the standard model of the V series.The V-Series uses a center mount system. By placing the tape transport mechanism in the center, which has high structural stability, weight distribution bias is eliminated. By eliminating weight distribution bias, the occurrence of chassis distortion, etc. is greatly reduced.In addition, since it is located away from the legs, the effect of external vibration is eliminated.The recording / reproducing head uses a high-purity PCOCC winding CA (cobalt amorphous) recording / reproducing combination 3head.The CA-head is a 14-layer thin-film laminate that takes advantage of its amorphous, non-crystalline structure. In addition, since the head can always be positioned accurately, the azimuth angle, high-frequency characteristics and phase characteristics can be maintained with high precision over a long period of time.A 3-motor system has been adopted for the mechanism part, enabling reliable operation of each section.A frequency distributed closed-loop dual capstan system is used for the driving mechanism.In the closed-loop dual capstan system, two sets of capstan and pinch rollers located on both sides of the head keep the tape tension constant and eliminate external influences such as microvibration to ensure excellent running performance.Based on this method, we adopted a frequency-distributed system in which the diameters of the left and right pinch rollers are slightly changed, which cancels the periodic fluctuation of the tachometer and greatly reduces wow flutter.In addition, the capstan has been subjected to a precision etching process on the order of sub-micron to increase the gripping force of the tape and prevent slight tape slippage. On top of a heavyweight bottom chassis, front and rear panels, a unique mechanical chassis and center chassis are firmly integrated to eliminate external vibration and internal resonance and to prevent twisting and bending of the body.It is equipped with an anti-static cassette stabilizer to suppress microvibration of the cassette half. In addition to the input, control, amplifier and display sections, the mechanism section is completely shielded to eliminate electrical and physical interference between the sections.The internal structure pursues high rigidity. In addition to the chassis exclusively for the mechanism part, it uses an independent side chassis and a center chassis connecting the front and rear parts. It is firmly assembled on top of the heavyweight bottom chassis that supports the entire bottom. Moreover, high rigidity is achieved by firmly integrating the front and rear panels and the inverted U-shaped top panel.The top panel is firmly integrated with the chassis body by 5-screw mounting to eliminate resonance.The V-7010is equipped with a side panel made of core wood with high mass and large damping effect on the side, which greatly suppresses vibration of the body.In addition, the chassis uses copper plated chassis.Equipped with an independent calibration system for left and right channels.When adjusting, the meter scale automatically changes and accurate adjustment is possible using the built-in oscillator.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro, high frequency characteristics can be improved.Equipped with Dolby B/C-NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a double FL display with excellent visibility.This display is equipped with functions such as digital peak margin display which accurately displays the instantaneous peak value in dB and linear time tape counter.It is equipped with CPS automatic selection function of 15songs in front and back.Equipped with CD direct function.In addition, it is equipped with a CD level check function that can easily tell the recording level of CDs.The power cord is a large-capacity OFC material with polarity indication.In addition, we have adopted parts such as recording volume with focus on the feeling of operation, gold-plated terminals with little deterioration, and custom-made capacitors for audio.It is equipped with functions such as return to 0function, auto monitor, auto tape selector, and auto rec mute for 4seconds.Power Load / Power Eject function enables smooth and reliable operation.It supports the CD sync function and can be synchronized with a Teac CD player with a CD/DECK SYNC connector.There are 2color variations of gold and black.Wireless remote control is included.The display can be turned on / off with this remote control."

## Description

"D/A converter that supports a wide range of input sampling frequencies from 32kHz to 192kHz.Input sampling frequency of 32kHz to 192kHz and 24bit input are supported.When 176.4kHz or 192kHz is used, two XLR inputs are used simultaneously to ensure stable transmission.It is equipped with a function that can upconvert up to 24bit/768kHz by 2kinds of algorithms.The digital filter section offers two selectable algorithms : FIR for HDCD and RDOT (Refined Digital Output Technology).It is also possible to customize the setting to the user'Ωs preference by combining up to 16times the oversampling order of the two connected series. For example, it is possible to sharply roll off out-of-band noise with FIR, and then reproduce the band exceeding fs/2with RDOT. This is an algorithm that realizes the natural sound characteristic of RDOT without any aliasing noise.RDOT supports 24bit / 44.1kHz input instead of 16bit / 192kHz input, and the maximum oversampling order has been increased from 8times to 16times.RDOT is an analog-and-complementary technology based on the full entropy theory to reproduce sounds at 20kHz or higher. The new RDOT used in the D-70is not only for CDs at 44.1kHz, but also for CDs at all sampling frequencies up to 192kHz. As a result, the new RDOT generates data in excess of fs/2by analog-and-generate music information that may have existed between the data. The new RDOT realizes more natural sound quality and reproducibility of sound field by making it possible to feel natural sound and differences in resolution and reverberation when instruments are overlapped.In addition to the new RDOT, a configuration of FIR DF + RDOT + newly developed AML circuit + high-precision 24bit4DAC realizes excellent information content.It is equipped with RAM Link (Refined Asynchronous Memory Link) which is a new circuit method unique to Eso Telic.In this method, a 128Mbit SDRAM is placed in the front stage of the DAC to improve the synchronization accuracy and realize an ideal jitterless D/A conversion. This circuit theoretically eliminates all jitter regardless of the input jitter or the frequency band, and achieves high-end specifications with a calculation error of 0.This circuit is equipped with a large-capacity RAM, which completely absorbs the jitter generated in the transmission line. By reading the data in the RAM with an internal high-precision clock, high-purity jitter-less data is sent to the DAC at the later stage. In addition, the large-capacity RAM is compatible with high-bit high-pulling, and long-time continuous playback is realized without fine adjustment of the clock frequency according to the remaining capacity of the RAM. In addition, the large-capacity RAM is capable of accepting large-capacity audio data increased by over-sampling or differential data.Equipped with a servo-less direct clocking system.In general, if an independent D/A clock is to be used in addition to the clock of the digital audio input signal, it is necessary to finely adjust the D/A clock frequency with a PLL or other device in order to synchronize the two clocks. Therefore, in high-end equipment, there was a proposition in circuit design that how to realize this frequency adjustment without losing sound quality.In the D-70, the clock control and adjustment circuit itself is completely eliminated, and the DAC is locked by oscillating the crystal of the audio frequency directly at a fixed frequency. This means that D/A can be completely asynchronously with the transmission frequency. Input jitter is not transmitted at all. In addition, the concern about the failure caused by the complete asynchronous operation is solved by increasing the RAM capacity (128Mbit).Word Sync output is installed.By connecting the internal clock of the DAC to the transport corresponding to the word sync, the clock is perfectly synchronized so that the jitter at the time of transmission can be ignored.The D/A conversion section uses four PCM1704multi-bit DACs manufactured by Bar Brown Co., Ltd. for a differential configuration.In addition, the digital data read from the RAM is isolated electrically once when it is sent to the subsequent stage. This prevents disturbance from entering the signal line and ground potential of the analog stage and realizes purer D/A conversion.The power supply is equipped with dedicated transformers for digital and analog circuits respectively to eliminate interference between circuits.In order to supply the optimum power supply voltage to each stage, each stage has its own regulator circuit to form a clean power supply circuit.Equipped with 7digital inputs of 3types (XLR/RCA/TOS).In addition, two types of analog outputs (XLR/RCA) and two TOS digital outputs are installed.Equipped with digital volume.Since the output level of the volume can be varied from 0to -60dB or - ¥, it can be directly connected to a power amplifier. The minimum step width is 0.1dB.Mass 8kg solid steel 8mm thick base board is adopted, and vibration and resonance from the outside are completely eliminated.In addition, pin-point foot &Ωbase made of high carbon cast iron is adopted at 2places on the front side and 1place on the rear side of the leg part, and the mechanical earth point is clarified.It uses 7Blocks Isolated Body Construction for internal construction.A 7-block structure consisting of a digital board, an analog board, a digital power board, an analog power board, an AC primary board, a word clock board, and a transformer section enhances the strength while achieving an electrical isolating effect.In addition, the chassis is a two layer plated chassis with nickel plated on 1.6mm thick copper plated steel sheet.In general copper plated chassis, an oxide film is formed on the surface and the contact resistance becomes high, making it difficult to achieve the same potential and low noise. In order to improve the earth potential and electromagnetic shield of the D-70, a thick chassis with two layer plating is used for all the chassis to realize the low impedance of the entire case.A space was provided on the rear panel so that the IEEE1394terminal can be upgraded.Wireless remote control is included.The D-70had a version upgrade service from 2003to 2005.In this version upgrade service, the precision of the internal clock is improved, and a high-precision crystal oscillator (within ¥3ppm, more than 10times the conventional one) is installed, and D/A conversion with higher precision can be performed.In addition to the conventional wordclock (sync signal) output function, a wordclock input function has been added to enable word-sync operation using an external master clock generator. This makes it possible to upgrade the entire system by combining a high-precision external master clock generator.In addition to the conventional 88.2/96kHz, this upgraded version has been upgraded to 176.4/192kHz word clock input / output in order to cope with high sampling of digital devices.Carefully selected high-quality parts were used for the parts. In addition, the initial model for the D-70user has been changed from the separate footstand type pinpoint legs to the integrated footstand type pinpoint legs for reliable installation. The footstand is unsteady, but when installed, it becomes pinpoint support and disperses vibration effectively. In addition, felt attached to the back of the footstand to prevent damage to the floor."

description:
## Description

"A D/D converter that can be used not only as a high-quality digital selector, but also as a digital preamplifier such as a sampling rate converter or digital gain control.There are four types and eight systems for input terminals : BNC Route 3, XLR1system, TOS Route 3and ST1system.In addition, in order to maintain the digital quality of the input signal, a balanced transmission method is adopted for all signal paths, and a Berry High-Speed C-MOS balanced type is mounted on the selector.The BNC terminals are compatible with RCA-pin terminals according to the supplied adapter plug.Digital signals are subject to time-axis distortion called jitter due to various factors that occur within the digital equipment, inherent to the source, or during transmission.Jitter is a variation in the spacing of the pulse train of the digital signal. If jitter increases, the accuracy of the quantization step decreases and the reproduced waveform differs from the original waveform.The DD-10uses a DSRLL circuit to resample the input digital signal and replaces it with a quartz precision clock to achieve higher performance by eliminating jitters over the entire audible range (0.5Hz to 45kHz) with more than 1/ 100and eliminating second order (12dB/oct) cutoff characteristics compared to the conventional first order.Two resampling frequencies, 44.1kHz and 48kHz, can be selected.The newly developed PLL mode is mounted in addition to the DSRLL mode.In this mode, the second PLL of the DD-10synchronizes the sampling frequency of the input digital signal with the sampling frequency. In the second PLL, a new mathematical digital phase detector digital loop filter that controls the lithium tantalate VCO very accurately eliminates the dead band of the phase detector, which has been a concern for a long time, and eliminates intermodulation distortion.Even in the PLL mode, jitter of 30Hz or higher is eliminated by the secondary cutoff characteristic (12dB/oct), greatly improving the quality of phase control.It has a digital PLL that clock isolates non-audio data.By sampling communication digital data with a crystal oscillator, we succeeded in clock isolating not only audio signals but also subcode signals.For the first time in the world, it is equipped with an epoch-making time control circuit that eliminates the possibility that non-audio data such as subcodes enters the audio circuit and thereby modulates the audio signal.Equipped with a high band selection switch, the cut-off characteristics of the digital filter can be changed.This function allows you to select two modes : Wide with slow and low attenuation characteristics and Narrow with steep and high attenuation characteristics. This function operates only in DSRLL mode.The DSRLL circuit circuit operates output signal from the input signal because of the asynchronous input / output operation. The interpolation operation used here is a combination of a 64x oversampling filter and a 1/128x decimation filter. A digital filter, which is not required in a normal synchronous circuit (PLL), is added. Two modes can be controlled by adjusting the coefficient and the number of taps of the output operation filter.It is equipped with an inbound noise shaping switching mechanism as an output bit number switching function.This feature uses quantization noise at the highest frequency in the band to improve resolution at relatively low frequencies, so that 20-bit information can be sent to DAT, DAC, CD-R, MD, etc. with a low number of effective bits (16bits / 18bits) without being truncated.Equipped with input polarity (operating polarity) switching function.This function switches the input operation polarity of the first stage PLL. Normally, DAIF (Digital Audio Interface Format) can communicate correct information regardless of the polarity of biphase mark modulated data.
