name: TEAAC
description:
## Description

"Surround processor with Dolby Pro Logic.Dolby Surround performs surround playback by applying a 15-30ms delay time to surround components (L/R 2-ch stereo signal and L-R phase difference signal). It is compatible with the Dolby Pro Logic system, which further enhances the realism of the normal surround system (Passive Dolby Surround) with the help of the directional enhancement circuit.The Dolby Pro Logic drives five speakers with four output channels : stereo 2ch (L/R), center (C) and surround (S).Here, by the function of the directional enhancement circuit, various components contained in the stereo 2ch signal are analyzed by the pro-logic circuit, and the L/R components, the S component which is the phase difference signal of L-R, and the C component which is the in-phase signal read by the high-precision level sensor are controlled. In other words, by strengthening the C relative to the L/R and emphasizing the level difference of the S relative to the L/C/R, stable center orientation and front-rear and left-right separation are ensured.In Dolby Pro Logic, a decoder (Active Dolby Decoder) reads the strength and weakness of the in-phase components of the L and R signals. If the strength is high, the C component is output from the center channel as the C component. At the same time, by rejecting the L and R signals, the C component is positioned at the front center.The center channel output can be selected from two modes, normal or phantom, depending on the system you are using and the source you want to see.It is equipped with 3surround modes which you can choose according to the software you want to play and the room.With matrix surround, you can enjoy outdoor concerts, stadiums, BGV, etc. with a sense of scale that envelops you from the front, back, left and right sides. The rear speaker is delayed to reproduce the expansion.Hall surround is designed to reproduce the sound of concert halls and live performances such as classical concerts. The rear speaker is delayed and echoed to reproduce the echo sound.Synthetic surround gives a stereo sound effect to a source of mono sound, with the front speakers playing pseudo-stereo and the rear speakers playing with delay.With built-in test tone circuit, the test tone is reproduced while moving sequentially from L Ï‰ C Ï‰ R Ï‰ S, and various settings can be adjusted.Equipped with a 5-channel surround indicator that allows you to check the current output level of each channel at a glance.It is equipped with a digital delay terminal to which you can connect a digital sound effector AV-D50, and a surround amplifier connection terminal.It has a built-in power amplifier for surround sound.Equipped with a one touch selector, input calibration mechanism, master volume, surround on/off switch, delay continuous variable knob, etc."

description:
## Description

"A digital sound effector that simulates the sound of a concert hall by simulating the indirect sound of the hall without losing the orientation, etc., and reproduces the sound and spread of a concert hall.You can enjoy digital surround sound by connecting to the AV-450D or AV-550D. The delay time can be changed in increments of 2.5ms, enabling fine control of the sound field.In addition to the conventional surround system using only the rear speaker, it is equipped with a side speaker output that enhances the surround effect, making it possible to reproduce sound fields with more natural and realistic sensation.In the presence delay mode, a cross feedback / echo function is installed to simulate complex reflection sound of a hall. The feedback amount can be adjusted independently on the left and right sides, and the delay time can be set independently on the left and right sides to reproduce a more realistic sound field of a hall.It also includes a balance knob for adjusting the volume balance between the main out and the presence out, and a master level control for adjusting the output of both the main and presence out.In order to effectively simulate the complex reverberation of a hall, a cross-feedback function is incorporated. description:
## Description

"Peak level meter unit slightly smaller than AP 300.The AP-100is a popular model with the same performance as the AP-300, and is especially recommended for cassette deck users.Equipped with a peak level meter.The operation principle of the peak level meter is different from that of the VU meter, which indicates the average value. The peak level meter always indicates the peak value regardless of the waveform. This is useful for recording with many peak components, and high-level recording can be performed up to the saturation point of the tape.The AP-100has a short attack time so that the peak can be indicated accurately even for instantaneous pulse signals. However, pulse signals shorter than 10ms are less audible even if they are clipped and distorted. Therefore, the AP-100uses an attack time of 10ms.A relatively long recovery time is used to make the guidelines easier to read.In order to monitor a wide dynamic range, the scale indication range is widened by the logarithmic amplifier.Especially, it is easy to read because the scale interval of around 0dB is wide.You can read the music power sent from the power amplifier to the speakers."

description:
## Description

"Direct drive type turntable equipped with magne-float system and electro-touch operation mechanism.The TN 400does not use mechanical switches such as microswitches or electromagnetic relays. Instead, it uses an operation method using a touch plate and transistor, which eliminates click noise.Each button is a self-illuminated lamp.A magne-float system is adopted to reduce the load on the bearing by utilizing the repulsive force of the magnet of the heavy turntable.Weight : 2.4kg Inertial mass : 325kg Ï‰ cm2Turntables have been adopted.In addition, this turntable is strictly dynamic balanced for each one.The motor is equipped with a 20-pole, 60-slot DC servo motor.This motor is an electronic commutator motor that detects the position of the rotor by three position detectors attached to the stator with a sense of 120� and a position detection magnet that rotates together with the rotor, and rotates by switching the drive current of the motor electronically.Electronic commutator motors have no brushes and are switched electronically, so there is no arcing and no electrical noise.The voltage generated by the back electromotive force of the coil wound in parallel with the motor-driven coil is applied to the feedback circuit of the servo circuit, and the motor is controlled to maintain a constant rotational speed.In addition to selecting highly efficient materials for the core material, a current of 8times that of constant speed rotation is supplied at the start, and a large torque is obtained at the start, enabling quick and stable constant speed rotation.The speed can be adjusted independently at 33and 45rpm.The number of revolutions can be checked with a self-illuminated strobe mirror.In order to obtain excellent regulation, it is equipped with a high-efficiency large cut core transformer and a stabilized power supply circuit, so that even if the power supply voltage is changed by 10%, the regulation of 0.5% fluctuation is obtained.In addition, in order to prevent the deterioration of the SN ratio due to electromagnetic vibration of the power transformer, the power transformer is mounted in a shield case with a pitch fit. In addition, the entire transformer is mounted in a raised state with a double rubber cushion.Equipped with a large level of 20mm diameter.There is a concentric groove of 10mm and 15mm in the center of the turntable for checking the overhang."
